CANONICAL_NAME.value: padasip 1.2.2 -- adaptive filters (LMS, NLMS, RLS, AP, GNGD) and adaptive system identification in Python (Matous Cejnek)

value.lineage: Widrow & Hoff's LMS (1960; the ADALINE rule) and its descendants -- normalised LMS, recursive least squares, affine projection -- as a small library for adaptive filtering, prediction and system identification. Genuinely ADAPTIVE: weights change online in response to error. Recorded honestly as an adaptive FILTER/identifier, not a closed-loop controller (the charter's 'genuinely adaptive controller' with pinned provenance was not found this batch; see the report).

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: online system identification and adaptive filtering

value.built_to: fit a model to a system whose parameters are unknown or drifting, one sample at a time, from the error alone
value.pressure: unknown/drifting plant, noise, step-size stability limits
value.success_means: the weights converge to the plant's; tracking resumes after the plant changes

value.pressure: unknown or time-varying plant, noise, real-time budget
value.failure_condition: step size too large: the weights diverge; too small: the filter cannot track the drift
